summary.text: Andrew Dimitri is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 25 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Dimitri's career experience includes working as an attorney.
He took office in the State Senate on January 7, 2025, succeeding Frank Lombardo III, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
